adaptation_notes: Official SoyDNGPNext model.yaml network built by official remodel(); official one_hot_CPU + np.resize tiling to 3x206x206 applied to the 33709-marker Wheat2000 panel exactly as upstream tiles shorter panels.
Wheat2000 binary 0/1 markers map to VCF codes 0/0 -> 3 and 1/1 -> 1 (loader guarantees no missing/heterozygous calls).
Target min/max normalization uses the current fit subset only; predictions map back to the released pheno scale per trait.

Official random 70/30 split and fixed epoch count replaced by Wheat2000 protocol inner folds, validation-PCC selection and median-epoch full-dev refit; same-protocol adaptation, not a paper reproduction.

rule: mean inner PCC of seed-averaged predictions; first configuration on tie; per-seed median best epoch and per-epoch median learning rate; full dev refit; outer test scored once
